answer: A seat is earned, not claimed: Slatebound borer kibble licence makes sure of that, since a licence borers renew after shaft trials. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Trying costs a 5-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The onyx is on the docket. The tally keeps tundra. Every falcon is counted once.
